correctness.rationale: The exact first-Hermite overlap |V_{h1}h_j|^2=e^{-s}s^{j-1}(j-s)^2/j! is radial and normalized (Gamma moment identity, including j=0); the area radial Jacobian is ds. Fixed-b Poisson local limit around j,s=n+O(sqrt(n)) gives F_b(u)=int_{u-b}^{u+b}y^2 phi(y)dy; large-deviation tails yield global norm and all maximizer offsets, not merely a finite truncation. F_b derivative and strictly decreasing outer-root logarithm classify center and two shoulders; envelope derivative D'(b)=2(h(b)-h(U_b+b))>0 for b>sqrt(2) establishes exactly one exchange. Independent SciPy root b=1.524046518926, U=1.751131023931 verifies the numerical values; numerical checks do not replace the Poisson-tail proof.
